about: The selection lane's kit capture (PLAN.md 3.4, 5.2 row 2), stage 2: /playground in the board layout at 1300 x 5094, scale 1 — the size of the Figma component board, where this lane's board cells sit (chipRow filter, chipRow wrap, segSwitch hug, segSwitch cells, uiSwitch, setCheck, and the badge in the actions lane's iconBtn cell); tiled with docs/pipeline/pulse/pkg/_int/kit-board-tiles.mjs. Opened through the remembered layout (localStorage) like F7's kit-board state; the playground sits behind RequireAuth and reads nothing the account owns; it replays from the freeze.
